senses.gloss:
Kucapañcāśikā
by Vṛttamaṇi Śrīnivāsācārya. Mysore I. p. 244.

Kucaragrāmadānapatra
d. 1391 A. D. Adyar II. p. 25a. On the grant of the village Kucara, re-named Mādhavapura, by Mādhava Mantrin, pupil of Kāśīvāsi Kriyāśakti an. a. of C. on Sūtasaṁhitā an. also Governor of Goa under Bukka I an. his younger brother Mārapa, of Vijayanagar.
For the text of the ins., the original of the Adyar ms., see JBBRAS. OS. VI. p.. 107-110, 115-6. For a critical study of it, see V. Raghavan, JOR. Madras, XII. p.. 295-9 where the persons mentioned in it are identified an. errors of earlier writers on it corrected. See also Adyar Library Bulletin, III. i. 1939. p.. 28-9.

Kucarudra_?
Up. BISM. Nasik Patawardhan 893. Perhaps Kaṭharudra Up.

Kucaśataka
(Beg. janani jaladhikanye jAyatAm) MD. 11936. Oppert II. 6110.
--text an. C. by Varada Viṣṇu. Hz. 1854.
--C. unspecified. TD. 23676.

Kucimāratantra
erotics. in 8 Paṭalas. C.. next entry.
Pt.. (1) Lahore, 1922. (2) Dhanvantari granthāvalī 17. Aligarh: Vijaygarh, 1925. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1906-28. 520. IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 1402.

Kūcimāratantra
Kāmaśāstra. by Kūcimāra. MD. 3894 (3 Paṭalas). See Kucumāra above p. 173.

Kucumārasaṃhitā
erotics. Oppert I. 7908. A Kūcimārasaṁhitā on erotics has been ptd. a. Lahore.

Kucelacaritakhaṅga
poem on the story of Ku. from Bhāgavata, in a metre called Khaḍga. fr. contained in Adyar ms. (Adyar II. p. 8b). See V. Raghavan, Mss. Notes, Adyar Library Bulletin, IV. p. 18.

Kucelavṛtta(prabandha)
campūkāvya. unspecified. Cranganore 465. Oppert I. 2799. Trippūṇittura II. 137.

Kucelavṛtta(prabandha)
campūkāvya. on the story of Kucela or Sudāman from Bhāgavata. by Melputtur Nārāyaṇa Bhaṭṭa. IO. 8130. 8131. Mysore. II. p. 9. TCD. 1361A. 1362A. 1390U (inc.). Trav. Uni. TM. 370A. TM. 374A. C.. 612U (last 2 inc.).
Pt.. in Mal. script.

Kucelavṛtta
by Vāsudevan Potti of Mutteṭat (1833-1893 A. D.) in Ceṅṅannūr in Kerala. See Contribution of Kerala to Skt. Lit. p. 267.

Kucelopākhyāna
paur. Oppert I. 1169. Ramesvaram 7. Sangam 20 (d) (Tel. sc.). Trav. Uni. 1206E (from Nārāyaṇīya). Trippūṇittura I. 281A. 286A.

Kucelopākhyāna
in songs written for Harikathākālakṣepa. by Svāti Tirunāl Rāmavarma, King of Travancore, 1813-1897 A. D.
Ed.. TSS. 112. [Page174-a.

Kucodyakuṭhāra
dvai. by Vijayīndra. See BNK. Sarma, His.. of Dvai. Lit. II. p.. 187-8.
A reply to it in Kannada called Ku. Ku. Kuṇṭhana is known. See list in App. p. 1, a. end of ‘Prāmānika eva Jivabrahmaṇor abhedah2’, Karwar, 1940.
